_notes_parts: Parts economy (docs/parts-contract.md; design doc 'Early Era, Parts & Maintenance'). Made at a Machine Shop (data/surfaces/fabrication.json recipes) from refined metals: parts (tier part) go into spare kits (tier spare: what repairs use) and construction parts (tier construction: building costs, later). They are ordinary resources: they sit in the player's stock and take storage space, volume per unit (1 for a part, 2 for a kit or construction part; every other resource counts 1). The design doc's recipes use plasma conduits, isolinear chips and transparent aluminum; nothing makes those on the surface yet, so the recipes use duranium, tritanium and parasteel only (control modules stand for circuit boards; isolinear later). Stored kits never decay. Tier drone: a packed scout drone (volume 3), made at a Machine Shop like the parts; a finished Drone Pad takes one from stock into each empty bay.
